修订记录（助手）：只重建画面左侧商用微波炉；排除家用机独占的镜头。按 40:33 像素宽高比还原参考视频显示比例，逐帧匹配主机结构，平滑相机轨迹并衔接分段标定。沿可见门边缘拟合开关门角度。 对4462与4589帧附近的主机进出画面边缘补正相机水平主点，20帧内平滑衔接，保留原片仍可见的机身细边。

review.frame_coverage: 6044 retained principal frames across17 camera-calibration segments, source210-4462 and4589-6379 inclusive, at2997/100 fps. Title and household-only interval excluded. Both encoded videos decode fully to6044 frames. Source declares6381 frames but only6380 decode, with the last retained source frame6379.
review.visual_review: All11 encoded start/middle/end comparison boards and22 extra encoded action/segment-boundary frames reviewed in animation_v002. Final animation_v003 reuses6004 native frames with SHA256 equality and rerenders40 corrected edge frames; seven final encoded boundary/hero frames reviewed on two boards. Opening/closing and continuous hand-held camera joins were inspected.
review.revision: Nativev088 retains long handle, rounded flush door and cabinet, recessed dark control membrane, stepped cavity liner and independent left-hinged door. Physical camera anchor interpolation plus source-flow joins removes artificial segment changes. Final principal-point shifts of up to8 raw horizontal pixels over40 frames retain the thin principal edge around4462/4589.
review.mechanics: Visible door free edge fitted during1675-1879; blurred and hand-occluded portions use interpolation. Household microwave action on the right is outside the selected principal asset. Hidden latch/hinge geometry is inferred.
review.geometry: Five cabinet/assembly checks pass. Structural door surfaces have no detected intersections at13 sampled angles; hinge/latch engagement excluded. This is not continuous clearance or force verification.
review.display_aspect: Source720x480 uses40:33 pixel aspect and20:11 display aspect. Paired input is scaled to800x440 and padded to800x450 with square pixels; generated output uses the same canvas.
review.alignment_limit: Not pixel-perfect. Hand-held lens/depth are inferred from visible structure; strong partial crops have weak depth constraints. Source blur, reflections, dark glass, fine labels and title overlays differ. Edge entry/exit has about1-2frame interpretation uncertainty. People, household unit and source room are outside the accepted scope.
review.scene: Frozen Tangyuan kitchen with shared external lighting and an estimated internal cavity lamp when open.
